thread:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: METRICS_SCRAPE_FAILURES fired for prometheus-scrape-prod (alert: scrape_fail_rate > 0.2)

maria (oncall): ack - i'm on it. seeing spike in scrape failures across frontend exporters.

sam_k: +1 acked. tagging prometheus owners @leo_sre for deeper look. any customer impact yet?

leo_sre: looking. quick check: prometheus-exporter-frontend pods 503’ing intermittently, about 30% error rate in last 3m. kafka consumer lag for log-ingest-topic is growing (~12k).

maria (oncall): thanks. can you run a `kubectl get pods -n metrics -o wide` and paste the failing pod logs?

leo_sre: running now, grabbing logs. snippet: ```
I0503 12:41:03.123 exporter.go:212] scrape target /metrics responded 503
error: read tcp 10.4.2.7:54432->10.6.1.9:9100: read: connection reset by peer
```

ops_matt: paging CS — looks like a few customers (acct-128, acct-402) have seen delayed dashboards in last 10m. Not widespread yet but measurable. tagging @cs_jane to prep comms. :loudspeaker:

cs_jane: on it. will draft a short note and hold until we confirm scope. any ETA?

maria (oncall): trying a rolling restart of exporter deployment to see if transient connections clear. command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/exporter-frontend -n metrics`

incidentbot: Automated action recorded: restart initiated by maria (oncall).

sam_k: if restart doesn't reduce errors we should consider scaling up exporter replicas or diverting scrapes to secondary region. what's current HPA status?

leo_sre: HPA at desired 4 -> current 4, CPU < 60%. Not CPU bound. Network errors look more like socket resets between exporter and client (prometheus scrape worker). investigating kernel logs on node-33.

maria (oncall): rolling restart complete. initial success: error rate down to ~8% in last 2m. kafka lag still rising — might be downstream backlog.

pd-notify: PD: incident escalated to L2 due to sustained kafka consumer lag threshold breach.

ops_matt: good on metrics recovery. Kafka lag likely due to burst during scrape failures — starting a consumer catch-up (backfill) job. will monitor.

cs_jane: draft ready: "We observed elevated metric scrape failures and delayed logs affecting dashboard freshness for a subset of customers. We are mitigating; updates every 15 minutes." want to send?

maria (oncall): please hold until we confirm kafka lag stabilizes. set update cadence to 15m. if backlog >20k escalate to platform team for more capacity.

leo_sre: kernel logs show a transient OOM kill on exporter process around 12:36 but container restarted automatically. i'll open a runbook ticket to increase socket backlog and add readiness probe tuning.

sam_k: +1 to readiness tuning. also add a scrape timeout bump for frontend exporters to avoid cascade. config change suggestion: `scrape_timeout: 10s -> 15s` in prometheus-staging before prod roll.

incidentbot: autopage dedupe check: this alert matches active incident 1759994200 (scrape-drop-event) — deduping linked alerts into active incident to avoid double pagers.

maria (oncall): good catch. linking threads and closing duplicate pager.

ops_matt: kafka lag now 6.4k and trending down after backfill started. dashboards catching up.

cs_jane: sending initial customer note now. will include link to status page and note that full freshness expected within 30-45m.

maria (oncall): keeping this thread open. next update in 15m or sooner if regression. if anyone needs to escalate to Dedicated infra, ping me. :thumbsup:

leo_sre: creating follow-up ticket: METRICS-2342 — tune readiness, bump scrape timeout, and add node network diagnostics to exporter runbook.

incidentbot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. auto-snoozed non-critical duplicate alerts.

maria (oncall): resolved for now; leaving assigned to leo_sre for follow-up. thanks team"
summary: PagerDuty alert for prometheus scrape failures; on-call acknowledged, rolling restart of exporter reduced errors; kafka consumer lag backfilled; customer ops notified; follow-up runbook and config changes created.
